calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT 'sales_dup_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_order_dup', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'return_dup', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_web_in_nonweb_store', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id <> 900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_nonweb_store', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'ws_store900_not_in_web_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
UNION ALL SELECT 'fully_loaded_false_P9_10', COUNT(*) FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (9,10) AND NOT fully_loaded
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders_ff_null', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE fulfilment_type IS NULL OR fulfilment_type NOT IN ('home_delivery','click_and_collect')
UNION ALL SELECT 'delivered_no_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL;

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
mine AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
m AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(v) AS mine FROM mine JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1),
c AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_gross, SUM(r.returns_net) AS ctrl_ret FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.mine, c.ctrl, m.mine - c.ctrl AS diff, c.ctrl_gross, c.ctrl_ret FROM m JOIN c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1;
